changeRecord.title: rigid end offset added
changeRecord.target: member BXA2.1, end j (half the depth of CB2.1)
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A rigid end offset says where the flexible length of a member starts: the part inside the joint (half the depth of the column or beam it frames into) does not bend. It shortens the flexible span and moves the point where the member end forces act on the joint, which adds the moment V x e to the joint. An offset that the structure does not have makes the member stiffer and shorter than it is.
changeRecord.precondition: a frame member end without an offset at a joint with a non-parallel frame member whose section has a depth (I, box, pipe or rectangle section)
